text:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/stream and related streaming routes. SLO breach: p99 > 1.5s. Affected cluster: us-west-2-canary-3. Incident ID INC-2244-01. Link: https://console.redwood/incidents/INC-2244-01

Maria R: paging oncall - @Sanjay K you're on for infra this rotation. can you triage? :rotating_light:

Sanjay K: on it. looking at dashboards now. p99 ~ 2.7s over the last 3m on streaming. p95 ~ 350ms. seeing streaming stalls and reconnects reported. pulling traces.

Sanjay K: initial hypothesis: recent rollout of model v11 introduced a fanout path that increases KV cache pressure. KV miss rate spiked around rollout timestamp. quick prom query i'm looking at: 
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/stream.*",cluster="us-west-2-canary-3"}[2m])) by (le))
```
kv_miss_rate went from ~0.02 -> ~0.28 in minutes after deploy.

Lee P: router logs show retries to encoder backends and some 503 spikes. tracing indicates a new code path in v11 that fans each request to 3 encoder pods for quality scoring. that multiplies cache pressure.

Alyssa C: CS report: multiple customers hit partial streams and reconnects. open tickets: #12345, #12346. Acme Corp flagged repeated stalls.

Jon H: ops idea: can we temporarily pin canary traffic back to v10 for that cluster, or enable the older single-encoder path? fallback to v10 should reduce fanout and KV churn.

Sanjay K: mitigation plan: start rollback v11 -> v10 on canary-3, and throttle rollout elsewhere. also bump router concurrency and reduce buffer window to avoid long queueing. Lee, can you initiate traffic-shift?

Lee P: starting rollback to v10 now for us-west-2-canary-3. command i'm using: 
```bash
redwood rollout set --cluster us-west-2-canary-3 --model traffic:v10 --duration 5m --force
```

incidents-bot: Deployment orchestration: rollback initiated by Lee P at 2244001285. Status: in-progress.

Sanjay K: applied router config change to reduce latency amplification: 
```yaml
router:
  max_concurrent_streams: 2000
  stream_buffer_ms: 50
```
restarted router pods in canary-3.

incidents-bot: Observability: p99 decreased from 2.7s -> 1.1s within ~2 minutes after rollback start. continuing to monitor.

Maria R: nice. tagging eng-runtime: need quick investigation on KV eviction policy and the new attention cache layout in v11. @Jon H can you validate encoder heap/kv metrics?

Jon H: running checks now. encoder kvcache eviction spikes align exactly with rollout time. memory churn higher under v11, looks like new attention cache layout allocates per-request buffers more aggressively.

Alyssa C: CS update: reconnects dropped significantly for most customers after rollback. Acme had some earlier failed streams but says issues reduced. support is on a call with them.

Sanjay K: marking incident as mitigated from paging perspective but incident not closed. owners: infra (Sanjay K) -> lead mitigations, eng-runtime (Jon H) -> RCA, encoders (Lee P) -> revert/fanout follow-up, CS (Alyssa C) -> customer comms.

Maria R: oncall handoff in 30m. if anything flares up, page the rotation. action items: revert fanout change in v11 branch, add KV stress test in CI, add rollout gating based on kv_miss_rate and p99.

incidents-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. paging closed at 2244001650. RCA required. RCA link: https://console/redwood/incidents/INC-2244-01/rca :memo:

Priya (CS Rep): note: contacted Acme engineering lead, offered postmortem + credits. they asked for ETA on permanent fix, wants a tech contact.

Jon H: i'll own the RCA doc and perf diff between v10 and v11. will include KV hit-rate, memory profiles, and a small reproducible workload to run in CI.

Maria R: thanks all. scheduling follow-up sync in #eng-releases in 1h to coordinate gating and hotfix plan. :thumbsup:
